four_node.mirror: Swap A/B and C/D, conjugate full coupling matrix and source presence. Reciprocal edges used.

listening.feedback: h*q enters A, -h*q enters B; this is a reduced ODE, not a new fluid force.

spatial.mirror: M[a](x)=-a(-x), forcing sin(x) invariant under M
spatial.method: Strang exact spectral diffusion + RK4 reaction/forcing, strict |mode|<N/4 for cubic dealiasing

interpretation: Finite-window diagnostics and model tests. No inferred fluid pitchfork, attractor, chaos, or coefficient equivalence.
